form.label: L2T - Windows Registry Forensics
form.description: Comprehensive Windows Registry analysis for digital forensics, incident response, and malware investigation

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | stats count by source_long | sort source_long
index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_key=coalesce(display_name, filename, description) | stats dc(registry_key)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | search (macb="*M*" OR timestamp_desc="*Modification*" OR timestamp_desc="*Modified*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-24h") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_hive=case( like(description, "*HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE*") OR like(message, "*HKLM*"), "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", like(description, "*HKEY_CURRENT_USER*") OR like(message, "*HKCU*"), "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", like(description, "*HKEY_USERS*") OR like(message, "*HKU*"), "HKEY_USERS", like(description, "*HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT*") OR like(message, "*HKCR*"), "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", like(description, "*HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG*") OR like(message, "*HKCC*"), "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by registry_hive

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | stats count by source_long | sort -count | head 8

panel.title: Most Active Registry Keys and Analysis

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_key=coalesce(display_name, filename, description) | eval key_category=case( like(registry_key, "*\\Run*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\RunOnce*"), "Auto-start", like(registry_key, "*\\Services\\*"), "Services", like(registry_key, "*\\Uninstall\\*"), "Software", like(registry_key, "*\\Network*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\NetworkList*"), "Network", like(registry_key, "*\\Classes\\*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\FileExts*"), "File Types", like(registry_key, "*\\Policies\\*"), "Policies", like(registry_key, "*\\Internet Settings*"), "Internet", like(registry_key, "*\\Explorer*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Shell*"), "Shell", true(), "Other" ) | stats count, values(macb) as activities, values(source_long) as activity_types, values(timestamp_desc) as timestamp_types, earliest(_time) as first_activity, latest(_time) as last_activity by registry_key, key_category, hostname | eval first_activity=strftime(first_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_activity=strftime(last_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Registry Value Analysis and Suspicious Entries

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | rex field=message "(?<value_name>[^:]+):\s*(?<value_data>.+)" | eval registry_key=coalesce(display_name, filename, description) | eval suspicious_value=case( like(value_data, "*.exe*") AND like(registry_key, "*\\Run*"), "Executable in Run Key", like(value_data, "*temp*") OR like(value_data, "*tmp*"), "Temp Path Reference", like(value_data, "*powershell*") OR like(value_data, "*cmd*"), "Command Line Tool", like(value_data, "*\\AppData\\*") AND like(value_data, "*.exe"), "AppData Executable", match(value_data, "(?i).*\\.(bat|cmd|scr|vbs|js).*"), "Script File", like(value_data, "*http*") OR like(value_data, "*ftp*"), "Network Reference", true(), "Normal" ) | where suspicious_value!="Normal" | stats count, values(value_data) as registry_values, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by registry_key, value_name, suspicious_value, hostname | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count | head 15

format.colorPalette: {"Executable in Run Key":#DC4E41,"Temp Path Reference":#F58F39,"Command Line Tool":#F8BE34,"AppData Executable":#D93F3C,"Script File":#F58F39,"Network Reference":#6DB7C6}

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_key=coalesce(display_name, filename, description) | eval security_category=case( like(registry_key, "*\\Run*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\RunOnce*"), "Startup/Persistence", like(registry_key, "*\\Services\\*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\CurrentControlSet\\Services*"), "Services", like(registry_key, "*\\Policies\\*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\PolicyAgent*"), "Security Policies", like(registry_key, "*\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall*"), "Software Installation", like(registry_key, "*\\Classes\\*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\FileExts*"), "File Associations", like(registry_key, "*\\Network\\*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\NetworkList*"), "Network Configuration", like(registry_key, "*\\Internet Settings*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Zones*"), "Internet Settings", like(registry_key, "*\\Windows\\Explorer*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Shell*"), "Shell/Explorer", like(registry_key, "*\\CurrentVersion\\Windows*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Winlogon*"), "System Configuration", true(), "Other" ) | where security_category!="Other" | eval risk_level=case( security_category=="Startup/Persistence", "High", security_category=="Services", "High", security_category=="Security Policies", "High", security_category=="System Configuration", "Medium", security_category=="Internet Settings", "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | stats count, values(macb) as activities, values(timestamp_desc) as timestamp_types, earliest(_time) as first_activity, latest(_time) as last_activity by security_category, registry_key, hostname, risk_level | eval first_activity=strftime(first_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_activity=strftime(last_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort risk_level

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_hive=case( like(description, "*HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE*") OR like(message, "*HKLM*"), "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", like(description, "*HKEY_CURRENT_USER*") OR like(message, "*HKCU*"), "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", like(description, "*HKEY_USERS*") OR like(message, "*HKU*"), "HKEY_USERS", like(description, "*HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT*") OR like(message, "*HKCR*"), "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", like(description, "*HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG*") OR like(message, "*HKCC*"), "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG", like(filename, "*SYSTEM*"), "SYSTEM Hive", like(filename, "*SOFTWARE*"), "SOFTWARE Hive", like(filename, "*SAM*"), "SAM Hive", like(filename, "*SECURITY*"), "SECURITY Hive", like(filename, "*NTUSER*"), "NTUSER Hive", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by registry_hive | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval macb_desc=case( macb=="M...", "Modified", macb==".A..", "Accessed", macb=="..C.", "Changed", macb=="...B", "Created", macb=="MA..", "Mod+Access", macb=="MAC.", "Full (MAC)", macb=="MACB", "Complete", true(), macb ) | stats count by macb_desc | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:registry" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$registryTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (description="*$hiveFilter$*" OR message="*$hiveFilter$*" OR display_name="*$hiveFilter$*") | search (description="*$keySearch$*" OR message="*$keySearch$*" OR filename="*$keySearch$*") | search (message="*$valueSearch$*" OR description="*$valueSearch$*") | eval registry_key=coalesce(display_name, filename, description) | eval registry_hive=case( like(registry_key, "*HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE*") OR like(registry_key, "*HKLM*"), "HKLM", like(registry_key, "*HKEY_CURRENT_USER*") OR like(registry_key, "*HKCU*"), "HKCU", like(registry_key, "*HKEY_USERS*") OR like(registry_key, "*HKU*"), "HKU", like(registry_key, "*HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT*") OR like(registry_key, "*HKCR*"), "HKCR", like(filename, "*SYSTEM*"), "SYSTEM", like(filename, "*SOFTWARE*"), "SOFTWARE", like(filename, "*NTUSER*"), "NTUSER", true(), "Other" ) | eval activity_risk=case( like(registry_key, "*\\Run*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\RunOnce*"), "High", like(registry_key, "*\\Services\\*") AND like(registry_key, "*ImagePath*"), "High", like(registry_key, "*\\Winlogon*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Policies*"), "Medium", like(registry_key, "*\\Uninstall*") OR like(registry_key, "*\\Classes*"), "Low", true(), "Low" ) | eval macb_desc=case( macb=="M...", "Modified", macb==".A..", "Accessed", macb=="..C.", "Changed", macb=="...B", "Created", macb=="MA..", "Mod+Access", macb=="MAC.", "Full (MAC)", macb=="MACB", "Complete", true(), macb ) | eval message_preview=if(len(message)>100, substr(message,1,100)+"...", message) | table datetime, hostname, registry_hive, macb_desc, timestamp_desc, registry_key, message_preview, activity_risk | sort activity_risk
